name: job-agent-browser
description: An agent-native desktop browser foundation for Job Agent Browser.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run quality && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/run-mcp-smoke.cjs && node scripts/run-mcp-server-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:agent: node scripts/test.cjs --agent && npm run build && node scripts/run-agent-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:profile: node scripts/test.cjs --agent && npm run build && node scripts/run-agent-smoke.cjs --profile
scripts.test:mcp-server: node scripts/test.cjs --mcp-server && npm run build && node scripts/run-mcp-server-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:ask-ai: node scripts/test.cjs --ask-ai && npm run build && node scripts/run-ask-ai-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:knowledge: node scripts/test.cjs --knowledge && npm run build && node scripts/run-knowledge-smoke.cjs
scripts.release:check: npm run model:verify && npm run check && npm run test:release && npm run test:embedding
scripts.package:dir: npm run model:prepare && npm run build && node scripts/package.cjs --dir
scripts.package: npm run model:prepare && npm run build && node scripts/package.cjs
scripts.release:build: npm run model:prepare && npm run release:check && node scripts/package.cjs --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.release:npm:check: npm run package:npm && npm run package:npm:verify && npm run test:npm
scripts.package:minimal: npm run build && node scripts/package.cjs --config electron-builder.yml

author: JAB contributors
